bug: The datapath reset is synchronous while the state-machine reset remains asynchronous.
trigger: After a completed transaction leaves nonzero ciphertext, assert reset and deassert it entirely between rising clock edges. The state resets asynchronously, but the datapath does not see a clock edge while reset is high.
effect: The old ciphertext remains visible during the reset pulse instead of clearing immediately.

edits.old:
always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            temp0
edits.new:
always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            temp0
